scope: Verify that three already-rejected modeler writer inputs do not replace a pre-existing DXF destination.

cases.name: unassociated AC1027 SAB
cases.input: Generated 3DSOLID whose raw bytes contain SAB data but no qualifying ACDSDATA owner association
cases.expected: Export rejects and sentinel destination remains byte-identical

cases.name: retained DWG object frame
cases.input: Generated modeler entity carrying a frame/body-size marker without a supported DXF payload representation
cases.expected: Export rejects and sentinel destination remains byte-identical

cases.name: declared modeler data with missing payload
cases.input: Generated AC1027 entity has modeler-data flag/version but no linked data-storage record or payload bytes
cases.expected: Export rejects and sentinel destination remains byte-identical

limitations: Synthetic writer-refusal coverage only; no ACIS semantic, native application, or independent-reader claim.
Does not cover every DXF version, modeler entity type, block graph, or failure point.
No fixture, dependency, or test registration was added.
No support claim or external J-item status changed; J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL.
